intro.title: FUNDA — Theme Toggle Switch
intro.body: In this lesson you will build a dark/light Theme Toggle Switch — a UI control that instantly switches the entire application's colour scheme and persists the user's preference across sessions. You will implement a ThemeService with a BehaviorSubject as the single source of truth, apply the active theme as a class on the document body using @HostBinding, and scope component styles correctly using ViewEncapsulation. The toggle widget consumes the theme observable via the async pipe and demonstrates how a singleton service broadcasts to multiple consumers with zero coupling.
intro.usecase: Global theme switching is present in almost every modern SaaS product — from VS Code and GitHub to Figma and Linear. It is also a textbook demonstration of the shared-service state management pattern. Understanding how to broadcast a single state change to multiple independent components without prop drilling or NgRx is a core architectural skill.
